scripts.sync:api: "${LAWGRAPH_DIR:-../lawgraph}/.venv/bin/lawgraph" openapi | python3 -c "import json, sys; json.dump(json.load(sys.stdin), sys.stdout, ensure_ascii=False, separators=(',', ':'))" > src/lib/api/openapi.json && prettier --ignore-path /dev/null --write src/lib/api/openapi.json && npm run types:api
scripts.check:api: npm run sync:api && git diff --exit-code -- src/lib/api/openapi.json src/lib/api/generated
scripts.sync:start: L="${LAWGRAPH_DIR:-../lawgraph}" && T="$(mktemp -d)" && git -C "$L" archive "${LAWGRAPH_REF:-origin/develop}" src | tar -x -C "$T" && PYTHONPATH="$T/src" "$L/.venv/bin/python" -c "from lawgraph.api.seo.pages.home import home_page; print(home_page('', '', True).body)" > src/lib/components/home/start-server.html; S=$?; rm -rf "$T"; exit $S
scripts.check:start: npm run sync:start && git diff --exit-code -- src/lib/components/home/start-server.html
